title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Falls 5.9% as Chip Stocks Slide (Nov 24)
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) fell 5.86% to $155.38 on Nov 24, 2026, giving back part of Monday's 31% surge as chip stocks slid and Fed rate-hike bets returned.
body_markdown:
## Why Nvidia Stock Fell


Financial media tied the drop mainly to a broad pullback in chip and AI stocks. According to[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-24-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-chip-stocks-nvidia-140629923.html) , investors pulled back after Monday's rebound, with Nvidia giving back some of its gains and the return of rate-hike expectations weighing on stocks. Traders moved back to pricing a 95% chance of a quarter-point Fed hike in December, the same report said.


Per[Yahoo Finance live coverage](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/live/nvidia-live-updates-nvidia-stock-falls-as-exuberance-fades-after-jensen-huangs-return-as-ceo-142100906.html) , the broader chip sector faced selling pressure as investors rotated out of tech and assessed the implications of Huang's return. Krishna Guha of Evercore ISI said, "AI stress is not mostly due to the Fed. But it is not a coincidence it is occurring when the Fed is hiking."


Monday's rally followed a company announcement. On November 23, Nvidia said its board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang as president, CEO and board director, according to[the company's official release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-board-reinstates-jensen-huang-as-president-ceo-and-board-director) . The board said it received input from senior levels of the US government and that Huang's reinstatement "poses no national security risk."


On Tuesday, Huang held an hourlong companywide meeting and told employees, "I made some terrible mistakes," as reported by Yahoo Finance citing The New York Times. The sources did not link the meeting to the stock's decline.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Nvidia's board said its vote to reinstate Huang was unanimous and that it is confident his return poses no national security risk, according to the company's release.
- The board has formed a National Security and Export Control Committee of independent directors and is searching for a new Chief Compliance Officer, per the same release.
- A Justice Department official said the department had no evidence of wrongdoing by Huang or Nvidia, as reported by Yahoo Finance.


### Risks


- The independent committee's investigation into whether Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort "will proceed to conclusion," Nvidia said.
- New York City Comptroller Mark Levine, whose funds hold about 5 million Nvidia shares, said the board had "done a total 180 without any explanation," per Reuters reporting cited by Yahoo Finance.
- Seaport Research Partners analyst Jay Goldberg said, "There are still real questions about their growth prospects," according to Yahoo Finance.
- Renewed bets on a December Fed rate hike weighed on chip stocks during the session, Yahoo Finance reported.


Huang is scheduled to testify before the Senate Banking Committee on December 3, according to Yahoo Finance.
